story.headline: Weber County, Utah, printer puts two ballots in as many as 167 voters' mail envelopes
story.summary: Weber County Clerk/Auditor Ricky Hatch said a miscalibrated envelope-stuffing machine at the county's contracted printer slipped two ballots into as many as 167 of the roughly 135,000 mail-ballot packets sent to voters. A voter who got two ballots alerted the clerk's office. Hatch said safeguards will stop any extra ballots from being counted, and his office has already caught several returned envelopes with two ballots inside.

quote.text: But a mistake by the printer hired by the county meant that as many as 167 of the envelopes sent to voters contained an extra ballot inside.

story.subject: official-or-institution

sources.title: Weber County sent two ballots to as many as 167 voters
Some Weber County voters received duplicate ballots, but clerk says count will remain accurate

story.headline: Big 12 says replay officials wrongly awarded BYU a touchdown in its win over Arizona State
story.summary: After No. 8 BYU beat Arizona State 27-20 in Provo, Utah, on Oct. 31, the Big 12 Conference said in a statement that replay officials should not have awarded a first-quarter touchdown. Running back Sione Moa had picked up a fumble by quarterback Bear Bachmeier near the goal line and was credited with a 1-yard score. The conference said the correct ruling was BYU ball, third and goal from the 2.

quote.text: Replay was incorrect in awarding a score. The correct ruling should have been BYU ball for a third and goal attempt from the two-yard line.
